notes.title: Version 1.005 Update! Steam Achievements!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your feedback; you wanted Steam Achievements, so here they are in this update!

Also The following have been fixed:
- Various bug fixes
- More Optimization (run faster)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.004 Update! Linux & Mac Shader Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your feedback, here's another patch. The following have been fixed:
- Fixed shader issues on Linux and Mac
- Fixed Input sometime not working on UI screen
- Bug fixes at boss fights
- Shader Optimization

Also we made a little video for those having trouble with the combat:
https://vimeo.com/186463114

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.002 Update! Optimization and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we just uploaded a new version (1.002).
In this version: 
- we optimized the game a bit more
- we fixed some bugs related to puzzles
- we retouched the first boss fight so that it's easier to understand and clear.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.0 Ready! Steam release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's with great pleasure that I announce our Steam release date:
Thursday August 18 2016

Our Steam page is online, please help us spread the word:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/270070/

It's been a long journey and me and my team are very grateful for this experience of making a first game as an indie developer. Again, Thank you :)

Salim & The Girl and the Robot Team
